info.name: Heritage VQA - Complete API
info.description: 81 API operations plus SSE replay/intermediate/Markdown variants. Default flags disable model calls, account creation/updates, editorial writes/review/publication, media writes, role assignment and destructive actions. Model-producing requests recheck live capabilities; live calls additionally require allow_live_model_calls=true AND live_model_consent=true. Source review additionally requires explicit reviewed_against_source attestation. DELETE/archive/withdraw require enable_destructive_actions=true and deletion targets are separate blank variables. Editorial auth accepts editor_access_token or server operations_token; role assignment requires admin_access_token or server operations_token. Session teardown runs last in folder15. Read docs/postman.md for per-feature setup. Templates contain no credentials or passwords.
